Once it ships, how long is delivery?
One Fast Cat • AI Assistant
Once an order ships, delivery usually takes:



West Coast: 1–3 business days


Central U.S.: 3–4 business days


Midwest: 4–5 business days


East Coast: 5–7 business days


International: typically 2–5 business days after it leaves the warehouse



You’ll receive a tracking email once the shipping label is created and the order is packaged.

Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
One Fast Cat • AI Assistant
There may be an expedited shipping option at checkout for domestic orders, but it does not speed up processing time before the order ships. In most cases, orders still need 1–2 days of processing before shipment, and processing can take longer during sales or holidays.
If your order has already been placed, the shipping speed cannot be added, removed, or changed. If the order has not yet been packed, you may request a cancellation and place a new order with a different shipping option. Once the order is packed or shipped, no shipping-speed changes can be made.
For international orders, shipping is already expedited by FedEx by default, and a faster option is not available.

turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
If tracking never updates, the help center says large orders may ship in multiple boxes, so first open your shipping confirmation and re-check the master tracking link for any additional associated shipments.
If there’s no second tracking number, or if something appears to be missing, you can contact support through their support page: https://onefastcat.com/pages/support.
If you want, I can also connect you with a team member.
